# The AI For Series

> Practical AI guides for accountants, auditors and finance teams: tested walkthroughs on practice files, answer keys, client-data routines and free tools. Written by Chandan Gupta, CA, CIA.

## Books
- [AI for CAs](https://aiforseries.github.io/ai-for-cas/): A practical guide to Claude Code for tax, audit, advisory and compliance work. For CAs in India.
- AI for Tax Practitioners: Run a faster, safer GST, ITR and bookkeeping practice with Claude Code. For Tax practitioners in India. Coming soon.
- AI for CA Students: Use Claude Code to study smarter for CA Foundation, Inter and Final, and shine in articleship, without cutting corners. For CA students. Coming soon.
- AI for Internal Auditors: A practical guide to Claude Code for risk-based audits, control testing, data analytics and reporting. For Internal auditors. Coming soon.
- Excel + AI for Finance Teams: Use Claude for Excel and Claude Code to clean, reconcile, model and report, and keep your spreadsheets auditable. For Finance teams. Coming soon.

## Free tools
- [Free GSTR-2B Reconciliation Tool (Runs in Your Browser)](https://aiforseries.github.io/ai-for-cas/tools/gstr2b-reconciler.html): Reconcile GSTR-2B with your purchase register free, in your browser: nothing is uploaded. Matches on GSTIN and invoice number, ties control totals and builds the ITC bridge.
- [AI Use Policy Template for CA Firms in India](https://aiforseries.github.io/ai-for-cas/tools/ca-firm-ai-policy-template.html): A free AI use policy template for Indian CA firms: what client data may be shared, consent, review, documentation, an engagement letter clause and an acknowledgement form.
